title: Compute marcher: ray setup validation and bounds debug
rationale: Reported visuals look like homogeneous fog with no coherent structure. Before tuning transport, validate ray generation from camera and volume AABB intersection. Provide an on-screen debug to prove rays and bounds are correct.
deliverables: Debug mode: visualize ray direction (world) mapped to RGB to validate raygen
AABB intersection debug: early-out if miss; optional overlay color when outside volume
Keybind to toggle debug modes; logging reflects current mode
PIX markers around ray setup and AABB tests
implementation: Generate rays from camera CBV(b0): origin, dir normalized; compute entry/exit t with volume AABB
If miss, write a distinct color and return; if hit, proceed to marcher (when not in debug)
When debug 'RayDir' is on, output normalized |dir| remapped to 0..1; skip marching
When debug 'Bounds' is on, tint pixels outside AABB and write step=0 into a UAV counter (optional)
acceptance: Rotating camera changes RayDir debug image predictably (no banding/inversion)
Bounds debug clearly distinguishes inside vs outside volume
No D3D12 validation errors; barriers unchanged from baseline
Toggle via keybind works and is logged
test_plan: Enable RayDir mode and rotate camera: verify smooth color variation matching camera rotation
Enable Bounds mode: verify box silhouette corresponds to volume AABB
PIX capture: verify constant buffers bound and no erroneous SRV/UAV states
